description: This file manages environment configuration validation and cache cleaning for the FreeCodeCamp client, including locale checks, environment variable validation, and cache invalidation logic.

methods.name: checkClientLocale
methods.description: Validates that CLIENT_LOCALE environment variable is set and is an available language.

methods.name: checkCurriculumLocale
methods.description: Validates that CURRICULUM_LOCALE environment variable is set and is an available language.

methods.name: checkDeploymentEnv
methods.description: Validates that DEPLOYMENT_ENV environment variable is set and is either 'staging' or 'production'.
